characters.summary: Pansy Parkinson is a Slytherin student during Harry Potter's time at Hogwarts, relying on standard defensive and offensive school charms and hexes during conflicts rather than exceptional combat prowess.
weaknesses: Lacks notable combat training outside standard Hogwarts curriculum
mobility: Broomstick flying as part of standard classes
limitations: Standard human physical capabilities and wand-dependent magic

sources.supports: General biographical details, Slytherin affiliation, and Hogwarts education.

campaignTags.claim: Uses a wand to cast standard magical spells taught at Hogwarts.

unknowns: Exact repertoire of advanced combat spells is not detailed in the text.

characters.summary: Parvati Patil is a Gryffindor student and member of Dumbledore's Army who fights using standard defensive and offensive charms learned at Hogwarts.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to surprise attacks and superior dark wizards
limitations: Relies on wand-based magic and human physical attributes

sources.supports: Membership in Dumbledore's Army and participation in Hogwarts battles.

feats.claim: Practices and casts the Reductor Curse and shielding charms during Dumbledore's Army training sessions.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Fought alongside other defenders during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Learns and casts defensive and offensive spells as a member of Dumbledore's Army.

characters.summary: Peeves is a poltergeist residing at Hogwarts who cannot be permanently destroyed or physically harmed by conventional means, choosing instead to cause chaos with thrown objects, pranks, and mockery.

mechanisms: Incorporeal poltergeist physiology granting immunity to physical injury and standard spells

weaknesses: Respects certain authority figures such as the Bloody Baron or Albus Dumbledore
limitations: Bound to the grounds of Hogwarts

sources.supports: Nature as a poltergeist, abilities, and immunities.

feats.claim: Wreaks havoc throughout Hogwarts, dropping heavy objects on people and defying staff members.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

unknowns: Exact origin and full range of poltergeist capabilities beyond mischief are not fully specified.

characters.summary: Percy Weasley is a Ministry of Hogwarts alumnus and official who utilizes standard administrative magic and wand combat when pressed into battle.
weaknesses: Overly bureaucratic and slow to adapt to sudden combat scenarios
limitations: Standard human physical and magical limits

sources.supports: Biographical details and participation in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Fights alongside family and Hogwarts defenders during the Battle of Hogwarts, duelling Ministry opponents.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Turned him into a sea urchin with assistance or during the final battle.

campaignTags.claim: Casts spells using a wand during magical confrontations.

characters.summary: Peter Pettigrew is an opportunistic wizard who relies on stealth, deception, and dark magical artifacts or transformations rather than direct fair duels.

techniques: Dark spells using a silver hand

weaknesses: Cowardly disposition; his magical silver hand can turn on him if he shows mercy
mobility: Animagus rat form for stealth and evasion
limitations: Physically weak in direct confrontation without element of surprise

sources.supports: Animagus form, betrayal, and silver hand details.

feats.claim: Killed Cedric Diggory using the Killing Curse during the Triwizard Tournament climax.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
notableResults.note: Ambush attack using the Killing Curse.

conditional.dependsOn: Magical silver hand provided by Voldemort

campaignTags.claim: Wields a wand to cast complex spells including the Killing Curse.

characters.summary: In his Animagus rat form, Peter Pettigrew possesses the physical attributes of an ordinary rodent, granting exceptional stealth and small-space infiltration capabilities at the cost of all offensive magic.

mechanisms: Ability to scurry into small gaps and tunnels

weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical hazards, predators, and traps affecting rats
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Peter Pettigrew from a human wizard into an ordinary-looking rat, removing all wand use and human speech while granting complete stealth and tiny-space infiltration.

sources.supports: Details of his rat form and living as Percy and Ron's pet Scabbers.

characters.summary: Pius Thicknesse is a high-ranking Ministry official who, while under the Imperius Curse, serves Voldemort's regime, utilizing standard Ministry-level offensive and defensive magic.
weaknesses: Subject to mind-control curses like the Imperius Curse
limitations: Dependent on wand magic and human physical limits

sources.supports: Role as Minister for Magic under control, and participation in the Battle of Hogwarts.

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of Hogwarts alongside Death Eaters against school defenders.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Defeated during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Casts advanced combat spells with a wand.
Operates under the influence of the Imperius Curse.

characters.summary: Pomona Sprout is the Head of Hufflepuff House and Professor of Herbology at Hogwarts, using specialized magical plants, poisonous fungi, and botanical combat tactics in battle.
weaknesses: Relies on preparation time to cultivate and transport combat-effective flora
limitations: Requires access to specialized magical greenhouses and plants for maximum effectiveness

sources.supports: Herbology expertise and combat use of magical plants.

feats.claim: Threw Mandrakes over the castle walls onto attacking Death Eaters during the Battle of Hogwarts, incapacitating them with their cries.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Used Mandrakes and Venomous Tentacula to repel invaders during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Casts standard wand charms in addition to her botanical expertise.

characters.summary: Queenie Goldstein is a powerful American witch possessing innate, highly developed natural Legilimency, allowing her to read and influence thoughts without verbal spells.
weaknesses: Emotionally vulnerable and susceptible to manipulation by powerful charismatic leaders like Grindelwald
limitations: Overwhelmed by intense, chaotic crowds with too many overlapping thoughts

feats.claim: Read the thoughts of numerous individuals concurrently without casting a spell.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

campaignTags.claim: Proficient in casting complex spells and charms with a wand.
Possesses natural, lifelong ability to read minds (Legilimency) of others without effort.

characters.summary: Quirinus Quirrell is a Hogwarts professor harboring Lord Voldemort on the back of his head, granting him access to dark arts and powerful parasitic magic at the cost of physical vulnerability.
weaknesses: Severe physical pain and blistering skin when touched by someone protected by loving sacrifice (Harry Potter)
limitations: Physically weakened and dependent on Voldemort's sustained presence

sources.supports: Role as Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher and host to Voldemort.

feats.claim: Conjured a wall of magical fire to trap Harry Potter in the underground chambers.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
notableResults.note: Defeated when Harry's touch caused severe blistering and physical disintegration due to protective magic.

conditional.ability: Enhanced dark magic and shared consciousness
conditional.dependsOn: Lord Voldemort attached to the back of his head

campaignTags.claim: Casts advanced defensive and dark magic spells.
